claim.statement: OpenAI's 0.90.0 release notes say the --yolo option skips the Git repository check when Codex CLI is run outside a repository.

source.title: OpenAI Codex release 0.90.0
source.locator: Bug Fixes — --yolo skips the Git repository check outside a repository (#9590)

values: current directory is outside a Git repository

limitations: The claim is limited to the repository check described in the release note; it does not infer every effect of --yolo.
The catalog did not invoke the option inside or outside a repository.
unknowns: The complete approval, sandbox, network and other authority changes implied by --yolo in 0.90.0 were not established from this source.
The filesystem scope and working-directory behavior outside a Git repository were not tested.
